digest.component_or_area: generated doc/config surfaces and drift gates
propositions: Plans and contributors cite derived files by line number without knowing they are derived, causing edits to be made to generated artifacts instead of sources, triggering drift gate failures and consuming multiple CI round-trips.
Two JSON-format derived surfaces (index.json and criterion-pins.json) carry no banner or marker indicating they are generated, unlike five markdown-format derived surfaces which already have banners.
A comprehensive registry of all nine derived/parity-gated surfaces does not exist in one place, requiring contributors to already know which files are generated in order to look them up correctly.

The two unmarked JSON files must be modified to carry a top-level `_generated_by` key as a fixed-point marker that survives regeneration byte-identically and does not interfere with downstream consumers.

Documentation in docs/README.md must enumerate all derived surfaces with their regenerate commands and CI gates, and distinguish hand-authored-but-gated surfaces from generated ones to prevent incorrect bannering.

Existing tests comparing on-disk derived files to in-memory builders must be updated to compare against the marker-bearing document shape rather than the pure builder, while pure builder invariant tests remain unchanged.
